_notes: Gurbashi Arena boss loot (2026-10-29). Five pits, five bosses, one item per kill from that boss's pool of four. item_level = creature level + 3. Budget and the five-way family spread are checked by audit() in tools/build_gurbashi_content.py. Nothing in here is quested.

Vek'tar the Unbeaten.name: Unbeaten's Notching Axe
Vek'tar the Unbeaten.flavor_text: He put a notch in the haft for every round he finished. The haft ran out first.

Vek'tar the Unbeaten.name: Purse-Taker's Breastplate
Vek'tar the Unbeaten.flavor_text: The crowd pays in one lump and he has never had to split it.

Vek'tar the Unbeaten.name: Never-Dropped Legguards
Vek'tar the Unbeaten.flavor_text: Scuffed to the knee and nowhere above it, which tells you how the rounds went.

Vek'tar the Unbeaten.name: Crowd-Caller's Spaulders
Vek'tar the Unbeaten.flavor_text: Somebody has to read the names out. It is a better job than fighting and worse pay.

Grateward Mok'tal.name: Stoker's Rod
Grateward Mok'tal.flavor_text: Long enough to reach the coals without leaning over the grate. Just.

Grateward Mok'tal.name: Gratekeeper's Robe
Grateward Mok'tal.flavor_text: Scorched through at the hem and patched from the inside, over and over.

Grateward Mok'tal.name: Vent-Opener's Gloves
Grateward Mok'tal.flavor_text: Two layers of hide and a lining nobody will name. He opens the vents by hand.

Grateward Mok'tal.name: Hot-Floor Treads
Grateward Mok'tal.flavor_text: Thick soles, and the trick of never putting a whole foot down at once.

Rakjan the Ribcracker.name: Pair-Handler's Rib Knife
Rakjan the Ribcracker.flavor_text: Short, because the work is close. He never had to use it on his own fighter.

Rakjan the Ribcracker.name: Ribcracker's Jerkin
Rakjan the Ribcracker.flavor_text: Cut wide across the shoulders and taken in twice at the waist since.

Rakjan the Ribcracker.name: Short-Round Hood
Rakjan the Ribcracker.flavor_text: Pulled down for the walk out. The rim does not get to see a face until it has paid.

Rakjan the Ribcracker.name: Bloodcaller's Tally
Rakjan the Ribcracker.flavor_text: A cord of knots, one for every round the handler called and his fighter finished.

Zul'gar Hammerfall.name: Hammerfall's Shear
Zul'gar Hammerfall.flavor_text: The head is flat on one face and drawn to an edge on the other. Both have been used.

Zul'gar Hammerfall.name: Hard Round Hauberk
Zul'gar Hammerfall.flavor_text: Relinked at the shoulder where something came through it and did not come through twice.

Zul'gar Hammerfall.name: Plate-Shearer's Bracers
Zul'gar Hammerfall.flavor_text: Armour comes off other people in strips and somebody down here keeps the strips.

Zul'gar Hammerfall.name: Hard Round Signet
Zul'gar Hammerfall.flavor_text: The fourth pit is the one the bookmakers close the book on. This is why.

Jen'shala, the House Favourite.name: Favourite's Gurbashi Pike
Jen'shala, the House Favourite.flavor_text: Longer than the pit is wide at the ends. She has never needed the ends.

Jen'shala, the House Favourite.name: House-Favourite's Sabatons
Jen'shala, the House Favourite.flavor_text: Nobody else in the five pits is shod. The house shods its own.

Jen'shala, the House Favourite.name: Odds-Keeper's Sash
Jen'shala, the House Favourite.flavor_text: The board in Booty Bay moved twice before anyone down here had heard your name.

Jen'shala, the House Favourite.name: Betting Token of the Last Pit
Jen'shala, the House Favourite.flavor_text: Stamped on one side, blank on the other. Which side is which depends who you ask.
